rows.note: Use 兩 before a classifier or noun for two items or a pair, rather than bare 二.

example.english: Two people are going to eat together.
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 jan4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 二 for the bare cardinal number and when counting or naming numbers, rather than 兩.

example.jyutping: ji6 gaa1 ji6 dang2 jyu1 sei3
